description: Sturmflutgebiet von 1962 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft (BUKEA). The data contain various information about the Hamburg storm surge of 1962: Pictures of the catastrophe, background information, eyewitness reports and radio contributions with interviews with eyewitnesses or scientists, which were created as part of a student project in Wilhelmsburg. In addition, the flooded area of 1962 is depicted. For more information: www.hamburg.de/sturmflut-1962. Coverage: Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft (BUKEA). The portal shows the English title as "Storm surge area of 1962" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Behörde für Umwelt, Klima, Energie und Agrarwirtschaft (BUKEA). Its keywords include Flut, ENVI, Geodaten, Flutgebiet. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
